title: Tip: set your holiday hours on Google

props.title: Set your holiday hours on Google

steps.small: Search your business name on Google while you're signed in.
Pick Thanksgiving and enter the hours you'll work, or mark it closed.

steps.big: Do the rest of the season too.
steps.small: Christmas Eve, Christmas Day and New Year's Day.
Nobody calls a company Google says is open and gets no answer.

props.outro: We build websites for home service contractors.
